summary: SiteDocument provides a model to associate document records with specific sites. It enables referencing documents for each site by site ID and document ID.
purpose: To represent and retrieve documents associated with sites in the application.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site the document is associated with

system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are used for storing and retrieving relationships between documents and sites.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin provides a user interface for staff administrators, displaying the last login information and handling UI elements for error and warning messages.
purpose: To provide a staff admin welcome dashboard, including feedback on login status and error handling.

entities.name: WelcomeStaffAdmin
entities.description: User interface for staff admin welcome

fields.name: lblTitle
fields.description: Displays welcome message and user name

workflows.name: Welcome display and session load
steps: SetupHSPnetPage is called on Page_Load.
Client scripts for WelcomeStaffAdmin and Date functions are registered.
User's name and last login time are displayed.
If login info exists, show last login panel.
On initial load, site dropdowns are filled.
Errors and warnings are processed for display.

system_behavior: Shows error or warning panels when required.

summary: ServiceCode defines a code entity linked to a category and includes fields for code description, alternative language, and notes. ServiceCodes provides business logic for retrieving lists of service codes, supporting localization.
purpose: To represent and manage different service codes for course, timetable, and all options, useful for categorization and localization.

workflows.name: ServiceCode retrieval
steps: Retrieve ServiceCodeListAll for all codes.
Retrieve ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID for course-specific codes.
Retrieve ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for timetable-specific codes.
Localization logic applies alternative language fields if enabled.

business_rules: Use alternative fields when localization is enabled.
system_behavior: Provides lists of service codes for use in forms and logic.
Supports localization for code names and notes.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records changes and actions performed on site profiles, tracking action date, user info, agency and contact details, as well as screen sections and user actions with support for localization.
purpose: To track, audit, and display site profile change history, including user and agency context.

entities.name: SiteProfileHistory
entities.description: Historical change entity for site profiles

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID who made the change

workflows.name: History retrieval
steps: SiteProfileHistorySearch called with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
History list is populated by FillList with localized fields if enabled.
User and agency context are formatted for display.

business_rules: Show support team annotation if actions originate from sysadmin or original user differs.
Format names and agency details for display.
system_behavior: Tracks all changes to site profiles with user and agency context.
Supports localized field values for bilingual deployment.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is used to manage documents shown in popup dialogs for email attachments. Provides logic for searching and deleting popup documents by parsing data strings.
purpose: To facilitate selection and deletion of documents in email popups, especially for attachments.

entities.name: EmailPopupDocument
entities.description: Document entity for email popup selection

workflows.name: Popup document search & delete
steps: Parse the DataInfo string for search, splitting by delimiter.
Build EmailPopupDocument list for selection.
Delete document by ID, remove file and containing folder, update string list.

business_rules: Delete action removes both the file and its folder if possible.
system_behavior: Parses data strings to populate popup document lists.
Deletes documents from disk and list.

summary: CostCentre represents financial and organizational breakdowns for placements, associating agencies, departments, sites, and services with cost centre codes. Business logic retrieves cost centre records and details for reporting.
purpose: To provide reporting and analysis of placements by cost centre, including department, agency, site, course, and financial details.

entities.name: CostCentreRecord
entities.description: Record entity for placement cost centre reporting

workflows.name: Placement cost centre reporting
steps: GetCostCentre retrieves records based on session, date range, and filters.
Records are summarized for reporting and analytics.

system_behavior: Aggregates placement financials and organizational data for reporting.

summary: ExpenseBatch tracks batches of expenses for departments, including batch description, date, and status. It supports searching, adding, updating, and deleting batches.
purpose: To manage and report on department expense batches for auditing and accounting.

workflows.name: Expense batch CRUD
steps: Search retrieves batches for department in the last year.
SearchID retrieves a specific batch by ID.
Add inserts a new batch.
Update modifies an existing batch.
Delete removes a batch.

system_behavior: Manages department expense batches and their lifecycle.

summary: TimetableAssessments manages student assessments for timetables, including workflow for adding, editing, deleting, and validation of assessment entries. Provides UI logic for assessor, subject, type, template, and validation for open/close days and special conditions.
purpose: To facilitate workflow for student assessments associated with timetables, ensuring proper validation and data entry.

workflows.name: Assessment Management
steps: Page loads and binds assessment grid.
Add/Edit/Delete actions handled with modal popups.
Fields validated for open/close days, and if special conditions (rotations, optional sections).
Validation checks for interim without final, instructor/supervisor overlap, and assessment max.

business_rules: Field values such as open/close days must be valid numbers.
Certain UI actions are only available to users with admin or coordinator roles.
Special conditions trigger notes and additional UI elements.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator ensures required fields are populated.
CompareValidator ensures open/close days are numeric.
CustomValidator checks business constraints (e.g., close days after today).
conditions: Show/hide UI elements based on selected values (assessor, subject, type, template).
Validate interim/final assessment relationships and maximum allowed.
system_behavior: Provides popups for editing and validating assessment details.
Handles workflow for adding, editing, and deleting assessment entries.

summary: AdHocQuery provides the logic to convert SQL data reader results into HTML table format. Used for flexible, ad hoc reporting and display of query results.
purpose: To render ad hoc SQL query results as HTML tables for display in help and reporting screens.

entities.name: AdHocQuery
entities.description: Utility for rendering queries as HTML

workflows.name: DataReaderToHTMLTable
steps: HeaderRow creates table header from column names.
DataRow iterates through each row, creates cell content.
FooterRow closes the HTML table.
NULL is shown for empty fields.

system_behavior: Converts arbitrary query results to HTML tables for display.

summary: StudentPrerequisites manages all medical, safety, and confidentiality prerequisites for students, with logic for tracking status, updating records, validating dates and codes, and detailed field-level description and business validation.
purpose: To record, validate, and update prerequisites required for student placements, including health and safety, immunization, mask fitting, and confidentiality.

entities.name: StudentPrerequisite
entities.description: Medical and compliance prerequisites entity for students

workflows.name: Prerequisite update and validation
steps: Update prerequisite fields based on submitted values.
Run validation to ensure dates and codes are within allowed ranges.
Execute update in database via procedure for each field/step.
Return errors if validation fails for date or code constraints.

business_rules: Dates for medical and immunization events must not exceed maximum allowed limits (usually 5 years).
Certain fields require mandatory values depending on prerequisites.
Year fields must be in acceptable ranges.
Expiry date must be valid if fit test is specified.
validations: Various date and year fields validated against current year and max years.
Fit test and expiry validations for mask prerequisites.
Mandatory fields for consent and medical completed dates.
conditions: Fields enabled/disabled based on prerequisite type.
system_behavior: Tracks all fields for prerequisite medical, mask, and confidentiality compliance.
Validates all business rules before updating.
Provides user feedback on validation errors.
